name: Tenjou Yukiha
source:
The protagonist of Fragment's Notes and Fragment's Note -After Stories-. He became depressed after being rejected by his childhood friend, [url=https://vndb.org/c20869]Yukitsuki[/url]. His life suddenly changed when his daughter from the future, [url=https://vndb.org/c20878]Miu[/url], travelled back to the past to give him a happy ending. 

He is currently living with his elder step-sister, [url=https://vndb.org/c20868]Haya[/url]. Yukiha has a strong incestual love for his step-sister to the point where they kiss each other on the lips every day. 

[spoiler]In Eri's route, Yukiha receives the nickname "Yuki-bear" from Eri.[/spoiler]
